sentences.en: There is not a physical explanation for this phenomenon yet.
sentences.zh: 目前还没有对这种现象的身体解释。

sentences.en: A dog is distinct from a cat in physical characteristics.
sentences.zh: 狗在身体特征上与猫不同。

sentences.en: Your physical body will wear out and die one day.
sentences.zh: 你的身体总有一天会衰老并死亡。
